messages:
maria_cs: Quick flag from today's account health sweep — three accounts trending down with different root causes. proposing a short 7-day "reactivation sprint" per account instead of a single heavy intervention.

maria_cs: Suggested lightweight plays: 1) Rapid SE audit + fix list, 2) Temporary billing/quotas relief for blocked tests, 3) Executive sync + tailored ROI one-pager. Run in parallel, low touch, measure lift at day 3 and day 7.

maria_cs: Targets: Solveta (110k ARR, renewal 27d), Parcelor (40k, renewal 75d), AzureLeaf (18k, renewal 6d). AzureLeaf is urgent.

jules_se: I can take AzureLeaf SE audit — 30m call. Agenda: 5m context, 15m walk through failing job logs, 10m immediate fixes + acceptance test. Can do tomorrow morning.

kai_data: trigger details for AzureLeaf — embedding pipeline error rate jumped to 18% (baseline <1%) and avg latency doubled. SQL I ran: 
```
SELECT account_id, metric, date, value, baseline
FROM account_signals
WHERE account_id = 'azureleaf' AND date >= '2026-03-01'
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

tom_accounts: For Solveta we should consider a 14-day invoice hold and a $750 workload credit to unblock UAT. i'll check billing constraints but flagged as option.

ops_bot: Billing hold suggestion logged: TICKET-CS-2231 (requires approvals from finance); created by tom_accounts at 2026-03-21T10:12:02Z.

maria_cs: timeline: Day 0 (today) — create tickets, SE audit scheduled for AzureLeaf, finance loop for Solveta hold. Day 1-3 — apply quick fixes & credits, monitor health_score and success_rate. Day 7 — review and decide escalation (renewal concessions or formal churn play).

jules_se: quick checklist I'll run on audit: 1) confirm model artifact checksum, 2) validate env vars for embedding service, 3) run sample payloads from their workload, 4) check job retry config. will paste checklist after call.

kai_data: adding dashboard card to watch these three: health_score, api_success_rate, avg_latency. pushing a small alert when avg_latency > 1.8x baseline. link: https://dash.redwood/cs/cards/reactivation-sprint-2026

maria_cs: AzureLeaf demo booked 2026-03-22 09:30 PT. Jules please drop the calendar notes and pre-reads.

tom_accounts: Solveta billing hold path: i'll ping finance lead and mark TICKET-CS-2231 as urgent. if approved, we'll schedule a one-time credit + hold until UAT passes.

maria_cs: success metrics: 1) +10% api_success_rate OR errors <2% by day 3; 2) no downgrade at next invoice for accounts within 30 days. secondary: capture feature gaps for product backlog.

jules_se: post-audit immediate fixes (if any) will be implemented as hotfix PRs and a temporary config override in the tenant namespace. I'll link PRs in this thread.

kai_data: sample alert payload i'm using to detect the issue: 
```json
{ "account": "azureleaf", "metric": "embedding_error_rate", "value": 0.18, "threshold": 0.02 }
```

maria_cs: capturing customer feedback ask: if we hear "our model outputs are unstable" => route to product with tags: output-stability, seed-variance. We'll keep a short feedback form in the post-call notes.

ops_bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled: 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z for re-checks and sprint review.

tom_accounts: noted. i'll prepare a short renewal-facing one-pager for Solveta summarizing ROI lift if UAT clears.

maria_cs: owners: AzureLeaf = jules_se, Solveta = tom_accounts, Parcelor = maria_cs. please react with :white_check_mark: when your action item is done so I can close the loop.

jules_se: :white_check_mark: (audit scheduled, checklist drafted).

kai_data: :white_check_mark: (dashboard card pushed).

ops_bot: TICKET-CS-2231 status: awaiting finance approval as of 2026-03-21T10:30:00Z.
